title: 第16章43军出来个宝贝啊

第16章43军出来个宝贝啊-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

门口进去是几栋很有年代感的红砖房，楼房门口挂着《解放军文艺》出版社的木牌子。小说组在二楼第一间，大爷走到二楼指了指，就转身下了楼。
楼道的灯光有点昏暗，油印味和煤气味非常浓。此时三月底各大单位已经停止了煤球取暖，但味道还没有散去。
刘济民走到挂着“小说组”铭牌的门口，轻轻敲了敲门，里面的编辑顿时都抬头看向了他。
“编辑同志，你们好，我叫刘济民，昨天给我打过电话。”刘济民站直了身体，敬礼后做了一个自我介绍。
“哦！刘济民同志，快进快进，是我给你打的电话。”屋子右墙边一个中年男人站了起来后，笑着迎了过来。
屋子里其余的编辑都好奇地盯着刘济民，嘴角发出“啧啧啧”的声音，也不知道在“啧”什么。
“你好，首长！”刘济民看到对方四个兜，再次敬了一个礼。
“哎呀，济民同志，在这里没那么多规矩。我叫李英，是小说组的组长。你的稿子我看过了，我们小说组也进行了二审，我们一致认为你写的非常好。没想到，在我们眼皮子底下，又出来了这么好的一个苗子。”李英满眼欣赏，嘴里赞叹声不断。
另外一个编辑站起来说道：“你的题材虽然是抗战题材，但没有那么多战争场面描写，而是将视角对准了儿童，全篇娓娓道来，这哪里是小说，简直是一篇散文诗，很对味！”
“谢谢大家的夸奖！”刘济民面带微笑，看向身前的李英问道：“李组长，您叫我来是要改稿子吗？我可以改的，咱们这儿有招待所吗？”
李英愣了一下，接着跟其余的编辑对视一眼，哈哈大笑：“济民同志，你想错了，我们对你的稿子非常满意，可以说是无可挑剔。我们之所以喊你过来，是想见见你。《光明日报》的文章是你发的吧？”
刘济民点了点头，李英拍了拍刘济民的肩膀，朝着其余人说道：“年轻就是好啊，热血敢言，吹起了年轻人思想解放的龙卷风。昨天我看到稿子的时候，就觉得‘刘济民’三个字眼熟，看了看地址，果然是你。
同志们对你都很好奇，想见见你。”
“一时心血来潮，心血来潮！”刘济民笑道。
“这可不是心血来潮，是你有文学积淀。”李英拉着刘济民坐下来谈论起《童年的朋友》这部作品，询问刘济民是如何想到以此切入的。
“我想写一篇与众不同的军旅题材作品，想了好久，有一天看到了当年延安小学的历史资料，于是开始动笔写了这篇小说。”
“好啊好，文章没有僵化的写作，处处透露着真实的情感。”李英再次夸赞道。
刘济民跟李英交谈了四十分钟，因10点后有课，他不能在此久留。
得知这情况后，李英遗憾地说道：“那咱们下次聊，走，你跟我来。”

Entering the entrance are several red brick buildings with a sense of age. On the door of the building is a wooden sign for the "PLA Literature and Art" publishing house. The novel group was in the first room on the second floor. The uncle walked to the second floor and pointed at it, then turned and went downstairs.
The lighting in the corridor was a bit dim, and the smell of mimeograph and gas was very strong. By the end of March, major units had stopped using briquettes for heating, but the smell had not dissipated.
Liu Jimin walked to the door with the nameplate "Novel Group" and knocked gently. The editors inside immediately looked up at him.
"Hello, comrade editor, my name is Liu Jimin, you called me yesterday." Liu Jimin stood up straight, saluted and introduced himself.
"Oh! Comrade Liu Jimin, hurry up, hurry up, it's me calling you." A middle-aged man stood up by the right wall of the room and came over with a smile.
The other editors in the room stared at Liu Jimin curiously, making "tsk, tsk, tsk" sounds from the corners of their mouths, not knowing what they were "tsk"ing.
"Hello, chief!" Liu Jimin saw the other party's four pockets and saluted again.
"Oh, Comrade Jimin, there are not so many rules here. My name is Li Ying, and I am the leader of the novel group. I have read your manuscript, and our novel group also conducted a second review. We all think that your writing is very good. Unexpectedly, under our noses, such a good idea has appeared again." Li Ying admired it with admiration and kept praising it.
Another editor stood up and said: "Although your subject is about the Anti-Japanese War, it does not describe so many war scenes. Instead, it focuses on children. The whole article is narrated. This is not a novel at all. It is simply a prose poem. It is very interesting!"
"Thank you for your compliments!" Liu Jimin smiled and looked at Li Ying in front of him and asked: "Team Leader Li, did you ask me to revise the manuscript? I can revise it. Do we have a guest house here?"
Li Ying was stunned for a moment, then looked at the other editors and laughed loudly: "Comrade Jimin, you are wrong. We are very satisfied with your manuscript, which can be said to be impeccable. The reason why we called you over is because we want to meet you. You published the article in Guangming Daily, right?"
Liu Jimin nodded. Li Ying patted Liu Jimin on the shoulder and said to the others: "It's good to be young. You are passionate and outspoken, blowing up a tornado of ideological liberation among young people. When I saw the manuscript yesterday, I felt that the three words 'Liu Jimin' looked familiar. I looked at the address and it turned out to be you."
Comrades are very curious about you and want to meet you. "
"On a whim, on a whim!" Liu Jimin laughed.
"This is not a whim, it's because you have a literary background." Li Ying took Liu Jimin to sit down and talk about the work "Childhood Friends" and asked Liu Jimin how he came up with this idea.
"I wanted to write a unique military-themed work. I thought about it for a long time. One day I saw the historical information of Yan'an Primary School, so I started writing this novel."
"Okay, okay, the article is not rigid in writing, and it reveals true emotions everywhere." Li Ying praised again.
Liu Jimin talked with Li Ying for forty minutes. He couldn't stay here because he had classes after 10 o'clock.
After learning about this situation, Li Ying said regretfully: "Then let's talk next time. Come on, you come with me."
